# DetailPro

## What DetailPro is

DetailPro is a growth partnership for auto detailing business owners in the United States. It is not a marketing agency, not a SaaS product, and not a course. It is a done-for-you system that installs the same lead generation, follow-up automation, and business infrastructure that the founder used to grow his own detailing company (Shine Squad, Minnesota) from $6,000/month to nearly $30,000/month in 2 months.

The founder is Brady Schlap — a detailing operator turned systems builder, not a marketer who learned about detailing. That distinction matters. He built and exited a real detailing business, then packaged the system into DetailPro so other operators can install it without figuring it out themselves.

DetailPro is not for beginners. It is built for detailing operators already doing $6,000–$15,000/month who have hit a ceiling and are ready to scale past it.

## The three offers

### 1. Marketing Partnership (core offer)

**Who it's for:** US detailing operators doing $6,000–$15,000/month. Operator mentality — texts leads back fast, does great work, open to systems.

**Who it's not for:** Beginners under $5k/month, hobbyists, detailers who won't follow up on leads, anyone looking for a one-way service with no involvement.

**Price:** $2,397 one-time setup fee (paid upfront, no payment plans) + 10% of monthly revenue (rev share starts when ads go live).

**What's included:**
- Custom high-converting landing page built for the detailer's local market
- Google Ads campaign — built, launched, managed, and optimized ongoing
- DetailPro Connect — proprietary software built by Brady from scratch (not GoHighLevel, not a white-label). Auto-responds to inbound leads within seconds, organizes leads in a dashboard, includes a fleet pipeline for B2B outreach, and a workflow builder that connects to scheduling software.
- Ongoing optimization and management of the full system
- Bonus stack included free: Sales Training Video ($497 value), Fleet Outreach Playbook ($297), Ceramic Coating Upsell Script ($197), Google Business Profile Optimization ($500), Partner community access ($97/mo value), The $20k Detailer ebook ($97)

**Guarantee:** If the system doesn't 2x the detailer's inbound lead volume from month 0 to month 1, Brady refunds the full $2,397 setup fee.

**Exclusivity:** One partner per metro area. When a market is taken, DetailPro will not run ads against its own clients. This is real scarcity.

**Why the pricing model is structured this way:** The 10% rev share means Brady only makes money when the detailer makes money. Flat-retainer agencies get paid whether results appear or not. This model aligns incentives — Brady is structurally motivated to produce revenue, not activity metrics.

### 2. Website + SEO (entry-level offer)

**Who it's for:** Detailers under $5k/month who need a real digital foundation before they're ready for the partnership.

**Price:** $597 one-time for the website build. Optional $300/month ongoing SEO retainer.

**What's included (build):** Custom Next.js website, fast load times, mobile-optimized, conversion-focused, local SEO foundation (schema markup, location targeting), booking-ready.

**What's included (optional SEO):** Backlink strategy, weekly blog articles for local search, on-page optimization, monthly performance reporting.

**The on-ramp:** Website clients who cross ~$5k/month are candidates for the partnership upgrade.

### 3. Consulting (back-end offer)

**Who it's for:** Existing partnership clients or operators with a specific bottleneck to solve. Not sold cold to new prospects.

**Price:** $199 for a single strategy call (~60 minutes, recorded). $200/hour for project work.

**Typical use cases:** Hiring first employee, pricing and positioning for new services, reviewing ad accounts, expansion decisions.

## Proof

- Brady took Shine Squad (his own detailing business, Minnesota) from $6,000/month to nearly $30,000/month in 2 months using the same system he now installs for partners.
- A detailer in New Jersey reached #1 on Google Maps in his local area within 30 days using Brady's Google Business Profile strategy — this was free advice, not a paid engagement. The same GBP optimization is included free with every partnership.
- DetailPro Connect auto-responds to inbound leads within 30 seconds — the single biggest revenue leak in most detailing businesses is slow follow-up.
- The 10% rev share model means Brady has never been paid by a client who didn't grow — the incentive structure is itself a proof point.

## What DetailPro is NOT

- Not an agency that charges flat monthly retainers regardless of results
- Not GoHighLevel or any white-label CRM product
- Not a course or coaching program
- Not for beginners or hobbyists
- Not for detailers who won't follow up on leads promptly
- Not available in markets already claimed by existing partners

## Brand voice and positioning

DetailPro speaks directly and specifically. It does not use agency language ("leverage," "synergy," "optimize your pipeline"). It does not make claims without proof. Brady positions himself as a fellow operator — someone who has done the thing and is showing others exactly how — not a consultant looking down at the industry.

The relationship DetailPro offers is a partnership with skin in the game, not a vendor relationship. "We only win when you win" is not a tagline — it is the literal pricing structure.
